annotation_notes: Reference annotations were written after visually inspecting the final image; generation prompts are not ground truth.
One viewpoint only: exact object dimensions and unseen walls are unassessed. Approximate positions must preserve major relationships, not centimeter accuracy.
Unannotated small decor is optional; unexpected-major-object checks must not flag incidental cups, books or cushions.
Shower reflections are not additional toilets or fixtures.
Vanity includes sink; preserve both features without forcing duplicate sink objects.
